 SEVENTEEN's 'white moonlight duo' achieves a miracle in the history of K-pop sub-groups.
 SVO - Jeonghan and Joshua (SEVENTEEN) sold over 800,000 copies in their first week, setting a new record for a K-pop unit.
 Báo Tiền Phong • 27/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 According to Hanteo Chart , the duo's debut mini-album, titled DREAMSCOPE , sold 804,949 copies in its first week of release (October 19-25), securing the top spot on the weekly album chart.
 On its first day alone, Jeonghan and Joshua's DREAMSCAPE sold over 650,000 copies, surpassing the previous record of 600,000 copies set by S.Coups and Mingyu (SEVENTEEN) last year. This is the highest first-day sales figure ever recorded for a K-pop unit album. 
 You may also like The duo also achieved impressive results on international charts. In Japan , DREAMSCOPE topped Oricon 's daily album chart for two consecutive days (October 20 and 21), and also secured the number 1 spot on Line Music 's "Album Top 100" chart. 
 In China , the album also topped the QQ Music best-selling digital album chart. Meanwhile, the title track, "12 O'Clock, " entered the iTunes Worldwide Song Chart at number 34.
 You may also like DREAMSCOPE explores the concept of a "dreamscape," where dreams intertwine, serving as a crossroads between subconscious fantasies and ideals of reality. The album comprises a total of seven tracks, including the title track.
 Additionally, Jeonghan and Joshua will kick off their tour titled JOURNEY INTO DREAMING at Inspire Arena (Incheon) from October 30th to November 1st.
